snippet.title: 逢魔之時 // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483600/_/

由台灣團隊小狐狸工作室製作的遊戲雛形，日系水墨風格的ARPG。利用技能組合擊倒Boss吧！
- - -
A prototype game created by Taiwanese team Little Fox Studio, this is a Japanese ink painting style ARPG. Use skill combinations to defeat the boss!

Developed by 
小狐狸工作室​
